== Ingredients ==
*4 whole [[Cookbook:Chicken#Leg|chicken leg]] quarters
*¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Hickory BBQ Rub|Hickory BBQ Rub]]
*1½ cups [[Cookbook:Maple Barbecue Sauce|Maple Barbecue Sauce]], divided

== Procedure ==
#Press rub into chicken. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
#Preheat [[Cookbook:Grilling|grill]] to medium high.
#Add chicken pieces and cook, turning often, 15 minutes.
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] chicken liberally with 1 cup barbecue sauce and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 165–170°F.
#Remove to a platter and cover with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]] and let rest 10 minutes.
#Serve warm with remaining ½ cup barbecue sauce.
